# First, extract the reason for retirement from the "time / retired" column for rows where it's not a time (i.e., does not contain a colon)
retirement_reasons = df[~df['time / retired'].str.contains(':', na=False)]['time / retired']

# Count the frequency of each unique retirement reason
reason_counts = retirement_reasons.value_counts()

# Check if "suspension" is the most common retirement reason
most_common_reason = reason_counts.index[0] if not reason_counts.empty else None
answer = most_common_reason == 'suspension'
